title.en: Multi-head attention comparison without head averaging

summary: Compare two to eight supplied attention heads from their separate projections through concatenation and the output projection while retaining each head identity.
objective: Compare two to eight supplied attention heads from their separate projections through concatenation and the output projection while retaining each head identity.
intent_signals: Compare attention heads without averaging them away.
Trace a selected query through every head and the output projection.
example_prompts: Compare attention heads without averaging them away.
negative_signals: Claiming a head is a causal explanation or linguistic concept from its weights alone.
not_for: Claiming a head is a causal explanation or linguistic concept from its weights alone.
Displaying only an average matrix when separate head outputs are required.

entities.name: Head lanes
entities.guidance: Keep projected Q_i, K_i, V_i, logits, row softmax and H_i selectable for every head.

entities.name: Concatenation gate
entities.guidance: Preserve head order and offsets before W^O; do not average heads.

entities.name: Output audit
entities.guidance: Show each head contribution to the selected final output coordinate through blocks of W^O.

state_contract.model: Accept real finite X_Q in R^(nq×dmodel), X_KV in R^(nk×dmodel), h in [2,8], nq,nk in [1,16], dmodel in [2,64], and per-head dk,dv in [1,16]. All numeric tensor inputs must be finite. The mask is a separate boolean permitted/excluded relation, not a numeric tensor. For each i require WQ_i shape dmodel×dk, WK_i dmodel×dk and WV_i dmodel×dv; compute Q_i=X_Q WQ_i, K_i=X_KV WK_i, V_i=X_KV WV_i and permitted logits L_i=Q_i K_i^T/sqrt(dk). Require every permitted logit finite, guard that every query has at least one permitted key, subtract the permitted-row maximum for stable softmax alpha_i, assign excluded keys exactly zero probability, and form H_i=alpha_i V_i. Concatenate H_1..H_h in declared order and require WO shape (sum_i dv)×dout with dout in [1,64]; Y=Concat(H_i)WO. Reject empty permitted-key rows, nonfinite numeric inputs or shape mismatch; do not encode exclusion by requiring an infinite numeric input.
state_contract.authority: Supplied finite tensors, ordered identifiers, basis conventions and provenance own semantic state. Blender/glTF assets are display-only; Three.js owns validation, calculation, linked selection, failure states and exact reset.
actions: Reset tensors, head order, mask and selection.

invariants: Every nonempty permitted attention row is nonnegative and sums to one within tolerance.
Each head output and concatenated block has the declared shape and order.
Y equals an independent Concat(H_i)WO recomputation within tolerance.
Reordering head lanes without identically permuting WO row blocks changes semantics and is rejected.
motion_guidance: Animate score, softmax, head output, concatenate and project as ordered explanatory stages from one frozen tensor state; motion has no computation time meaning.
creative_affordances: Choose any coherent laboratory, constellation or sculptural art direction while preserving exact labels, selectable identity and non-color encodings.
known_limits: Documentary authored recipe only; no model training, checkpoint execution, quantum hardware, Blender export, browser, renderer or interactive runtime was run.
glTF transports neutral display assets only; tensors, checkpoints, citations, basis order, dtype and provenance remain external data.

claims.statement: Multi-head attention applies distinct learned query, key and value projections to each head, runs attention in parallel, concatenates the head outputs and applies a final output projection.
claims.scope: The multi-head attention definition in the Transformer paper; no claim that head weights explain model causality.

source_refs.locator: Section 3.2.2, MultiHead and head_i equations and projection matrix shapes

object_craft.structure: Blender authors a modular row of head frames, token tiles and one concatenation/output gate at neutral transforms; node names encode only visual part identity.
object_craft.material: Shape and line style distinguish queries, masks, probabilities, values and projected outputs; head color is redundant.
object_craft.articulation: Three.js owns matrices, stable token/head IDs, masks, all tensor arithmetic, block highlighting and reset.

physical_contract.scope: Finite imported-data calculation and explanatory playback; no physical dynamics, model training, quantum device or causal attribution.
